run_f_gold: run f_gold to count subarrays with equal 1s and 0s in a binary array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct subarray counting results
review_f_gold: review f_gold prefix sum approach for counting equal 1s and 0s subarrays

refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array when replacing zeros with negative one
